definitions.name: local routing excludes Claude executor instructions without changing Jev task extraction
excluding local executor instructions still retains follow-up evidence and bounded Unicode excerpts

assertions.expression: assert.equal(state.current_task, 'Prove whether both can commit; specify the atomic repair.')

definitions.name: Nimble, Tev1, and compatible custom aliases use the same native protocol without chat requests
Ollama scores all three tiers natively with the frozen policy and no Jev confidence threshold
malformed native answers fall back safely without caching or consulting Jev
Ollama preserves the local metadata gate and gives safe version guidance only for its missing endpoint
Ollama shares one deadline across metadata and native response, cancels bodies, and bounds output
a disabled deadline accepts delayed metadata, inference, and body reads with or without a caller signal

assertions.expression:
assert.rejects(evaluateOllama(buildOllamaState(body()), config({ ollamaTimeoutMs: 20 }), { signal, fetchImpl }),
      error => error.name === 'AbortError' || error.name === 'TimeoutError')

definitions.name: caller cancellation with no deadline stops metadata and inference body reads without caching a fallback
an already cancelled request with no deadline never contacts Ollama

assertions.expression: assert.fail('Cancelled evaluation must not send metadata or prompt requests')

definitions.name: multibyte local context stays inside the byte budget and excludes private thinking and images
a cloud alias or unknown metadata is rejected before any prompt text is sent
large local model metadata is accepted within its separate bound while oversized metadata is rejected
Ollama failures with a disabled deadline never contact Jev, are not cached, and retain an existing Opus request
caller cancellation propagates and local classifier keeps continuity and capability guards

assertions.expression: assert.rejects(evaluateOllama(buildState(body()), config(), { signal: controller.signal, fetchImpl: async () => metadata() }), /cancelled/)

const metadata = () => Response.json({ details: { parameter_size: '9B' }, capabilities: ['completion'] });
